metadata.description: Comprehensive SEO analysis plugin for Claude Code. 26 sub-skills and 19 sub-agents, plus 9 optional MCP extensions (Matomo, DataForSEO, Firecrawl, Banana, Ahrefs, SE Ranking, Profound, Bing Webmaster, Unlighthouse). v2.3.1 runs the judgment-heavy agents on Opus, adds a free Keywords Everywhere backlinks fallback, surfaces setup failures with their own output, and makes every extension installer write ~/.claude.json atomically.
